system.description:
When this spell is cast, one or more creatures will imagine the caster to be their best friend, and treat them accordingly. It does not make them fanatically loyal and will not make them attack their other friends. Similarly, it does not create any romantic attachment and does not override consent.

This spell works on any living creature, but not on undead or nonliving creatures such as automatons. If cast on creatures with 3 hit dice or fewer, it will affect 3d6 targets, otherwise it will affect only a single target. In either case, all targets get a spell save to avoid the effect.

If a target fails its save, then it gets another one periodically to throw off the charm effect. The frequency of the save is based on the creature's intelligence:

0 Intelligence = save every 120 days 1 Intelligence = save every 90 days 2 Intelligence = save every 60 days 3 Intelligence = save every 45 days 4–5 Intelligence = save every 30 days 6–8 Intelligence = save every 15 days 9–12 Intelligence = save every 7 days 13–15 Intelligence = save every 3 days 16–17 Intelligence = save every 24 hours 18 Intelligence = save every 8 hours 19 Intelligence = save every 3 hours 20 Intelligence = save every hour 21–29 Intelligence = save every 10 minutes 30+ Intelligence = save every round

If the caster behaves in an overtly hostile manner to the charmed target, such as attacking it or ordering others to attack it, then the charm is broken.

If an immortal is charmed using this spell, they may make a save every 10 minutes even if they have less than 21 Int.
